job: Finish reusable application blocks and remove workflow proof workarounds
primaryTask: Configure an existing tested application block and complete record workflows

defects.problem: The distributed registry has no complete application blocks
defects.evidence: registry.json lists only shine, personal, brand and swatch; scaffold produces adapter-only
defects.expectedEffect: Consumers install composed controls with executable workflows

defects.problem: Product reuse is a prose instruction without source enforcement
defects.evidence: design-packet creates imports for primitives but supplies no reusable block binding
defects.expectedEffect: Existing product implementations are found and required before new installation

defects.problem: Modal and later-panel controls are required visible at initial load
defects.evidence: proveUsability waits for every object before executing any flow
defects.expectedEffect: Real dialogs and tabs can be tested at the point their controls appear
